$comment: Per-file counts of repeating, zero-delay and dropped-handle timers in production source, checked by scripts/check-timer-ownership.mjs. Owned by topics/architecture-mandates.md#timer-ownership. Lower with `pnpm timers:check --record`; a new entry or a higher count needs maintainer approval.

packages/client/src/components/EmulatorS.stops: Video-health and adaptive-bitrate checks for one mounted stream; each effect's cleanup clears its interval.

packages/client/src/components/ExternalS.stops: Elapsed counter while the banner is visible; the effect cleanup clears it. gaps/one-second-clocks-have-private-intervals.md

packages/client/src/components/ForkSumma.stops: Elapsed counter while the summary is generating; the effect cleanup clears it. gaps/one-second-clocks-have-private-intervals.md

packages/client/src/components/HostedRou.stops: Pairing countdown while a pairing is pending; the effect cleanup clears it. gaps/one-second-clocks-have-private-intervals.md

packages/client/src/components/PendingTo.stops: Elapsed counter while the warning is mounted; the effect cleanup clears it. gaps/one-second-clocks-have-private-intervals.md

packages/client/src/components/Processin.stops: Quiet-time tick while a turn is processing and the indicator is in the viewport; the effect cleanup clears it.

packages/client/src/components/ProjectQu.stops: Countdown tick while the project queue has items; the effect cleanup clears it. gaps/one-second-clocks-have-private-intervals.md

packages/client/src/components/RemoteAcc.stops: Relay status refresh only while the relay is connecting or registering; the effect cleanup clears it.

packages/client/src/components/RendezAtt.stops: Auto-send countdown while the tab is visible and a send time is pending; clears itself at the send time and in the effect cleanup.

packages/client/src/components/TemplateC.stops: Elapsed counter while template creation is active; the effect cleanup clears it. gaps/one-second-clocks-have-private-intervals.md

packages/client/src/contexts/AgentConten.stops: Polls a ref every 100 ms for another caller's load; cleared when that load lands or after 30 s. gaps/agent-content-duplicate-load-polls-a-ref.md

packages/client/src/extension/sidepanel/.stops: Side-panel refresh while mounted, skipped when hidden; the effect cleanup clears it.

packages/client/src/hooks/useBrowserDebu.stops: Lease countdown while the debug lease is active; the effect cleanup clears it. gaps/one-second-clocks-have-private-intervals.md

packages/client/src/hooks/useFileActivit.stops: Reads the activity bus connection flag each second while enabled, for want of a disconnect event; the effect cleanup clears it. gaps/one-second-clocks-have-private-intervals.md

packages/client/src/hooks/useGitStatus.t.stops: Safety refresh while a git-status consumer is mounted and visible; stopSafetyRefresh and the effect cleanup clear it.

packages/client/src/hooks/useMessageList.stops: Arrow-button auto-repeat while the pointer is held; stopSearchArrowRepeat clears it on release, cancel and unmount.

packages/client/src/hooks/useNeedsAttent.stops: Tab-title activity cadence while session activity is shown; the effect cleanup clears it.

packages/client/src/hooks/useRelativeNow.stops: The shared clocks: a minute clock that runs only while it has subscribers, and a per-caller interval cleared on unmount.

packages/client/src/hooks/useSession.ts.stops: Durable-history fetch while a sent message is still unconfirmed; the effect cleanup clears it when none remain.

packages/client/src/hooks/useSessionPerf.stops: One page-lifetime sweep of the session-detail memory cache, created at module load and never cleared.

packages/client/src/lib/browserDebugLeas.stops: Event flush while debug instrumentation is installed; the returned removal function clears it.

packages/client/src/lib/browserDebugPerf.stops: Performance window sample while the recorder runs; stop() clears it.

packages/client/src/lib/connection/Conne.stops: Default implementation of the injected timer interface; its one caller is the stale-connection check, cleared on disconnect.

packages/client/src/lib/developmentPerfo.stops: Development-only clearing of native performance measures; the returned uninstall function clears it.

packages/client/src/lib/diagnostics/Clie.stops: Telemetry entry while log collection is on; _stopTelemetry clears it.

packages/client/src/lib/speechProviders/.stops: Cross-tab lease heartbeat while this tab holds the idle microphone stream; cleared when the lease is released.

packages/client/src/lib/streamedDownload.stops: Service-worker keepalive for one download; cleared when the download settles.

packages/client/src/pages/settings/Messa.stops: Rendez status refresh while the settings pane is mounted; the effect cleanup clears it.

packages/desktop/src/main/LauncherView.t.stops: Server status refresh while the launcher view is mounted; the effect cleanup clears it.

packages/desktop/src/main/ServerOutputVi.stops: Server output refresh while the output view is mounted; the effect cleanup clears it.

packages/relay/src/telemetry.ts.stops: One connection-count sample per recorder; close() clears it.

packages/relay/src/ws-handler.ts.stops: Ping for one waiting connection; cleared when it pairs or closes.

packages/server/src/app.ts.stops: One draft-store cleanup per app, unref'd; the app's dispose clears it.

packages/server/src/artifacts/ArtifactSe.stops: One grant and deletion sweep per artifact server, unref'd; close() clears it.

packages/server/src/indexes/SessionIndex.stops: Warmup progress log while warmup jobs exist; stops itself when the last job ends.

packages/server/src/lib/processIdleSweep.stops: The process-wide idle-release interval, unref'd and created outside request context; cleared when the last sweep unregisters.

packages/server/src/logging/resource-sam.stops: One resource sample per process when sampling is on, unref'd; the returned stop function clears it.

packages/server/src/logging/stall-record.stops: One event-loop stall check per process when recording is on; the returned stop function clears it.

packages/server/src/projects/projectGlos.stops: One glossary poll per project with a subscriber, unref'd; cleared when the last subscriber leaves.

packages/server/src/projects/projectWork.stops: One fallback reconciliation poll per project with a subscriber; cleared when the mode changes or the last subscriber leaves.

packages/server/src/remote-access/Remote.stops: One hourly expired-session cleanup per service; shutdown() clears it.

packages/server/src/routes/android-host-.stops: Transport liveness comment for one summary stream; cleared when the stream is cancelled.

packages/server/src/routes/ws-relay-hand.stops: One heartbeat per session-watch, glossary and worktree subscription; each subscription's cleanup clears its own.

packages/server/src/routes/ws-relay.ts.stops: WebSocket ping for one direct or relay-accepted connection; cleared on close and on a failed ping.

packages/server/src/sdk/providers/claude.stops: One output tail poll per Claude process while a Bash call is running, unref'd; cleared when the last tail stops.

packages/server/src/server-main.ts.stops: One attachment-staging TTL cleanup per server, unref'd; cleared on shutdown.

packages/server/src/services/BangCommand.stops: Output preview flush for one running bang command; cleared when the command exits.

packages/server/src/services/ProviderIns.stops: Lease-file heartbeat for one provider installation; the returned stop function clears it when the install ends.

packages/server/src/services/RelayClient.stops: Keepalive for the one relay connection; stopKeepalive clears it on disconnect.

packages/server/src/services/RendezWatch.stops: One watch reschedule per service while Rendez watching is enabled, unref'd; cleared when disabled or closed.

packages/server/src/services/host-awake/.stops: Power-state sample for the one host-awake lease, unref'd; cleared when the lease is released.

packages/server/src/subscriptions.ts.stops: One heartbeat per session and per activity subscription; each subscription's cleanup clears its own.

packages/server/src/supervisor/Process.t.stops: Replay-bucket swap for one provider process, idle or not, until it terminates. gaps/replay-bucket-swap-is-a-per-session-interval.md

packages/server/src/supervisor/Superviso.stops: One stale-process check and one liveness probe check per supervisor, both unref'd; stopBackgroundTasks clears them.

packages/server/src/watcher/FileWatcher..stops: Fixed-file poll for one watcher where inode watches are unreliable, unref'd and created outside request context; stop() clears it.

packages/server/src/watcher/FocusedSessi.stops: File poll and path-resolve retry for one focused session target; cleared when its last viewer unsubscribes.

packages/client/src/components/Conversat.reason: Chrome dispatches the adjusted touch click in the pointerup task; the guard drops on the next task. The handle is kept and cleared.

packages/client/src/components/FileViewe.reason: Reads the selection after the browser has applied the pointer or key event that changes it; coalesced and cleared in the effect cleanup.

packages/client/src/components/MessageIn.reason: One is the fallback where requestAnimationFrame is absent. The other reads the caret after the browser applies the click, with no handle.

packages/client/src/components/NewSessio.reason: Reads the textarea selection after the browser applies the click, with no handle; the same shape as MessageInput.

packages/client/src/components/Resizable.reason: Suppresses the click that follows a column drag in the same task; no handle is kept.

packages/client/src/components/SessionSh.reason: Focuses the URL field after the state update that renders it, with no handle; a commit-time focus would not need a timer.

packages/client/src/components/SourceCon.reason: Keeps click suppression through the compatibility click dispatched in the pointerup task. The handle is kept and cleared.

packages/client/src/components/session-s.reason: Yields the main thread between scan slices so typing stays acknowledged; the scan checks cancellation after each yield.
Moves title fitting out of the keyboard echo's pre-paint commit; coalesced and cleared in the effect cleanup.
Yields the main thread after 8 ms of matching so typing stays acknowledged; checks cancellation after each yield.

packages/client/src/components/ui/Toolti.reason: Keeps the blocked activation through the click dispatched in the pointerup task. The handle is kept and cleared.

packages/client/src/hooks/useBtwAsides.t.reason: Focuses the aside composer after the current key event finishes, with no handle.

packages/client/src/hooks/useCodeFenceRe.reason: Fallback where requestAnimationFrame is absent; the refresh is coalesced by a flag.

packages/client/src/hooks/useComposerDel.reason: Fallback where requestAnimationFrame is absent, for the post-send focus boundary.

packages/client/src/hooks/useMessageList.reason: Runs a history search page off the calling task where Worker is absent.

packages/client/src/hooks/useSelectionAc.reason: Reads the selection after the browser finalizes it for the pointerup, with no handle.

packages/client/src/hooks/useSessionMess.reason: Lets the loading-progress row paint between transcript load steps, only when that progress display is enabled.

packages/client/src/hooks/useTranscriptD.reason: Reads the caret the browser places after the press dispatches. The handle is kept and cleared.

packages/client/src/lib/browserDebugLeas.reason: Reconciles the persisted lease after pageshow restores the page from the back-forward cache, with no handle.

packages/client/src/lib/imageActions.ts.reason: Revokes the object URL after the synchronous download click has captured it.

packages/server/src/routes/security-clie.reason: Starts the revocation cascade after the handler returns its response on a non-SRP transport; SRP transports use deferAfterResponse instead.

packages/server/src/services/issues/cont.reason: Yields the event loop between pages of a finite content pass, abortable through the pass's signal.

packages/client/src/components/QuestionA.reason: Scrolls the Other input into view 100 ms after focus, a guess at when the on-screen keyboard has opened.

packages/client/src/components/UserTurnN.reason: Releases marker-click suppression 800 ms after a long press opens the notch menu; nothing clears it on unmount.

packages/client/src/components/blocks/To.reason: Repeats the expanded-row scroll 80 ms later, a guess at when the expanded content has laid out.

packages/client/src/components/renderers.reason: Revokes a PDF object URL once the tab it was opened in has had time to load it; no owner outlives the click.

packages/client/src/contexts/ToastContex.reason: Auto-dismiss for one toast; an early manual dismiss leaves the timer to fire as a no-op on the app-lifetime provider.

packages/client/src/hooks/useCodeFenceRe.reason: Copied-state reset on a code fence's copy button. gaps/copied-flash-timers-have-private-copies.md

packages/client/src/lib/connection/Relay.reason: Forget an abandoned request id, or a closed subscription id, after the window in which a late reply can still arrive; each deletes one set entry.

packages/client/src/lib/streamedDownload.reason: Removes the download frame once the browser has had time to hand the response to its download manager.

packages/server/src/maintenance/server.t.reason: Exits the process after the reload response is sent and provider installs have drained.

packages/server/src/network/listeners.ts.reason: Destroys a retired listener's remaining sockets after its grace period, unref'd; the listener is already closed.

packages/server/src/routes/server-admin..reason: Exits the process after the restart response is sent, for the supervisor to restart it.

packages/server/src/services/BangCommand.reason: Escalates to SIGKILL after the grace period if the command is still running, unref'd.
